description: A Terasic DE10-Lite FPGA board with an Intel MAX 10 10M50 chip, 10 switches, 2 keys, 10 LEDs, six seven-segment displays and an Arduino header.
summary: The board runs the user's Verilog in the iynk cycle simulator. Ports stand in for pins: switches, keys, LEDs, the seven-segment displays and the Arduino header outputs. It does not synthesise a design or time it.
clock: Clock input: 50 MHz on the board.
activelow: Active low: 0 means pressed or lit.

models.1: Verilog subset run by the cycle simulator with the DE10-Lite ports, one pin per port bit.
models.2: Switches, keys (active low), LEDs, the six seven-segment displays (active low) and the Arduino header as outputs.
models.3: A design that declares CLK_HZ runs at 100 kHz instead of the 50 MHz board clock.

not.1: Synthesis, timing closure and constraint files.
not.2: The ADC, the accelerometer, VGA and the SDRAM.
not.3: Block RAM sizing and the electrical limits of the pins.

gap: No electrical ratings are listed yet, so no pin-overload check exists for this board.
